You could also add Skydeck in Willis Tower and the Theatre District from the official Loop guide [d4].  
Other retrieved suggestions that complement those core downtown sights include The Magnificent Mile, architecture tours such as CAF or Wendella, and possibly Navy Pier, depending on how broadly you define “downtown” [d2][d7][d8][d9].  
If you want a simple downtown plan, the evidence supports focusing first on the Loop: Art Institute, Millennium Park/Bean, Cultural Center, river cruise, and Riverwalk [d1][d4].
